newsitem.title: USA: ASR sees Q2 charge for acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: ASR sees Q2 charge for acquisitions.

text.p: ASR Investments Corp said Thursday that it has completed several previously announced acquisitions and the sale of a joint venture and will take an approximately $5.25 million charge in its second quarter.

As a part of the transactions previously approved by the company's shareholders, ASR completed the acquisition of the entire interests in Pima Mortgage LP and Pima Realty Advisors Inc by issuing 262,008 shares of common stock.
As a result, the company said it become a self-administered and self-managed REIT.

The cost of the Pima acquisition of approximately $5.25 million is assigned to the contracts between the company and the Pima entities. ASR said the cost is a non-cash expense charged to income as contract termination expenses in the second quarter of 1997 and will not reduce the cash provided by operating activities or the company's ability to pay dividends.

In addition, ASR said it completed the previously announced acquisition of 13 apartment communities and one office building as well as the related property management company. The total purchase price of the properties is approximately $83,223,000.

To finance the transaction costs of these acquisitions, the company assumed or refinanced first mortgage loans totalling $49,396,000, issued 683,626 shares of common stock, issued operating partnership units that will be convertible to 942,184 shares of common stock after one year, paid the sellers $1.25 million for transaction costs and issued to Don Winton, the general partner of the sellers of the properties, 70,284 shares to acquire the property management company.

ASR has also completed the acquisition of the entire interests held by its partner in the La Privada Apartments LLC for $8,233,000 and sold to its partner other interests for total net proceeds of $2,062,000.
With these acquisitions, the company said it has accomplished its goal of converting into an apartment REIT and will continue to explore opportunities to acquire other apartment communities.
